tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i bsnyen yig mi bskyod dgongs rgyan bzhugs so// swasti/ rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings/ /bde chen 'gyur med longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang gsum 'dus sku sprul pa'i sku/ /bla ma mi bskyod rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang gi lam gyis grol brnyes pa/ /'phags bod paṇa grub thams cad dang / /rgyud 'di gsung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bstan srung tshogs kyis dge legs stsol/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bskyed rim la/ /brten nas grub gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i bsnyen pa yi/ /rnam dbye cung zad bshad kyi nyon/ /'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i bsnyen thabs nyung ngu'i ngag gis bkod na/ de la spyir bsnyen pa rab 'bring tha gsum gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ rab yi dam lha'i snang ba thob pa zhig yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'bring mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa yin te/ klu sgrub kyi dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ mtshan ma nges par thob pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ mtha' ma grangs bsnyen yin te/ grangs ni gtso bo la 'bum dang / 'khor la khri bzlas dgos pa yang / dkyil chog de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor bdag po bzlas pa 'bum/ /de las gzhan pa khri ru bzlas/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ 'gos kyi stong thun dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho sogs rang lugs kyi yig cha rnams las kyang de bzhin bshad pas de ltar bya ba'am/ yang na spyi 'gres bzhin bzhi 'gyur bzla dgos pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ rdzogs ldan la ni bzlas bya gcig /nyis 'gyur gsum ldan la bzlas bya/ /gsum 'gyur gnyis ldan la rab brjod/ /rtsod ldan bzlas pa bzhi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa bzhin 'dir zla ba gcig la gtso bo la bzhi 'bum dang / 'khor la bzhi khri bzla ba'i dbang du byas nas bshad na gnas la sogs pa bsnyen pa la dgos pa'i mtshan nyid rnams rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams kyi lugs dang sbyar bas zhib bshad re bla ma gong ma mang pos rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi bsnyen yig rnams su gsungs pas 'bri ma dgos shing /

bris kyang snyigs dus blo chung rnams chos la don gnyer chung zhing / 'jig rten kyi bya ba la spros pa che bas/ dam pa'i chos kyi zhib bshad dam/ bod chos rgyal gyi dge khrims lta bu'i mtshon pa'i 'phral yun du phan pa rnams zhib gleng byas tshe tshig nyog tu go nas rna ba dang / mig gi spyod lam du mi 'gyur ba'i thabs kho na byed pas 'dir yang de dang cha 'dra snyam nas snying po dmar bsdus su bkod pa ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas mtshams ma grol gyi bar rang dbang can byi dor byas la bla re yol ba sogs ci 'byor gyi rgyan dang / rten gsum rnams/ bkod pa mdzes par bzhugs su gsol zhing / khyad par gsang 'dus chos srung dang bcas pa'i sku bris 'bur gang rung la zhal phyogs pa'i drung du mchod gtor bshams pa'am/ rten rnams med kyang rung / rang gi mdun sogs thag nye 'gyang gang rung du stegs bu bang rim ras sogs kyi kheb can 'bru bkram pa la/ bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i zlum gtor mtheb skyu can sha mar dang sogs kyis brgyan pa 'das gtor dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma byed na/ dang po 'das gtor gnyis pa gur gsum pa zhal bzhi pa las mgon lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi phyogs skyong gzhi bdag gi gtor ma rnams bshams/ yi dam dang chos skyong gzhan la 'bul bzhin pa yin na/ de dag gi gtor ma'ang rang rang gi phyag len bzhin dang / de rnams kyi drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod sbrengs tshar dang / thun gzhan la dgong mo thun la ni nges par byed dgos/ gtor bsngo byed na kha gso rgyu'i mtheb skyu gtsang ma grib skam ma phon men/ de gos las snyug ma sogs kyi bskam pa/ gtor ma rnams chu chang gis sbyong chas ku sha'i 'thor yab sogs dang / gu gul ring bu sogs spos ci 'byor 'dus byas pa'i drung rdo shing sa phag sogs gang rung gi sgrom steng rang gi mal bshams pa'i 'og sa dkar gyis rdo rje rgya gram bris/

mal gyi mdun du lcog steng rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas rnams dang / yi dam chos skyong gzhan la gtor ma 'bul skabs dkrol dgos na ḍā ma ru'ang bsham/ bza' btung me shing mtshams g.yog gnyis gsum lha rje sogs kyang dgos skabs dang bstun pa'i gra bsgrigs/ phyogs mtha'i yi ge rnams kyang thog ma nas dmigs khongs su bcug pa'i/ lan 'debs mal min pa nas btang / der ma 'thus pa byung na/ yi ge sogs zhag gnyis gsum phyir bzhag rim gyis spos bdug nas nang du blang ste lan byed tshul 'dra/ dad gshin gyi dkor rdzas la shin tu 'dzem/ gnas khang phyags dar mi bya/ sngas stan lcog rtse sogs mi spo/ skra sen kha spu mi 'breg khrus mi bya/ mtshams tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar 'phros gtam ye mi bya ba'am/ de tsam ma lcogs na thun gyi sgang la gzhan dang 'phros pa lta ci/ chig lab dang gsol 'debs/ yi dam gzhan gyi sngags 'dren pa sogs mi bya/ chab gseng sogs kyang mal kho nar snod du bya ba las thun skabs longs pa dang 'gro mi nyan/ mtshams la zhugs nas 'go dal/ bar 'jur/ mjug dal ba zhig dgos pa sogs blang dor rnams ma brjed par byas nas zla ba gang yang rung ba'i mar ngo'i nyer gsum sogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la thog mar gnas khang der cha gsum yid ches pa btang / bgegs gtor phyir dor ba'i tshe/ khro sngags du mas bsngags pa'i yungs dkar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug sems kyis gnas khang bgegs dang bral bar thag bcad/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol rang dbang 'dus par tho dkar mngon can bris pa'am rtsig pa gang rung la phyag len rgyas pa ltar na rgyal chen bskyed chog sogs bya ba'am/ bsdu na bgegs bskrad brtan bzhugs shis brjod bya ba'am/ shin tu bsdu na bris btsugs gang rung kho nas chog pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams phyag len la sna tshogs snang ba'i phyir ro/ /thams cad mi rtag par 'dug pas/ sems kyis 'jig rten gyi spros pa phal cher thag bcad/

dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams dran zhing / rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam la brten nas 'di phyi bar do skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pa rnams la nges shes brtan pos blo bla ma dkon mchog la lings kyis bkal la/ 'grub min gyi the tshom dang / zla khang 'di la nges par song na snyam pa'i sdug brtsir de 'dra ma yin par/ blo lhod byas la phyi rol dgra gnyen bar ma'i snang tshul dang / nang nad gdon cho 'phrul sems la rnam rtog 'char sgo gang byung yang / dgag sgrub spang blang mi bya bar/ kho rang gi ngang du bshig nas zas spyod sman sogs mthun rkyen bsten pa dang / bying ba byung na/ gnas khang bsil dkar gos sogs srab cing / zas cung zad nyung ba dang / bzlas dmigs la hur gyis sgrim/ rgod nas sems mi chags pa 'ol rgyu rgyal 'byams sogs byung na/ gnas khang dro mun/ gos dro/ zas bcud can bsten/ mngon rtogs dang sngags sogs shub bu bya/ 'khrid thob pa yin na bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin la zhugs pa'am/ de min bzlas dmigs la rtse gcig dang / tha na tshig rjes la sems hril gyis 'gro ba zhig byas nas bsnyen pa tshad ldan zhig bya snyam pa'i blo yang yang gsal btab la/ thog ma rang gang la mos pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang / shes na brgyud 'debs kyang bya/ mtshams la zhugs pa'i thun dang po la gnas khang dang mchod rdzas byin rlabs bya dgos pas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ bsangs/ oṃ shun+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/

steng thog rim par phub cing rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i nang gi mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ oṃ las mchod yon/ paṃ las me tog dhaṃ las bdug spos/ daṃ las mar me/ gaṃ las dri chab/ naṃ las zhal zas/ shaṃ las rol mo/ hūm̐ las mchod rdzas gzhan rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ gi bar sa pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i mthar/ dharma ra ṇi lan gsum/ gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thun gzhan rnams la 'di mi dgos/ bsgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don bla ma gong mas mdzad pa sna tshogs yod kyang / las dang po pa rnams kyis sgrub thabs rgyas pa nyams su blang bde ba ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan phan don yod nyid zhes gsungs pas de bzhin nyams su blangs pa bzlas pa la grangs bzung / thun gyi rjes gtso bo don dam la bzhugs pa dang / glus bskul bzhengs bstod sgrub thabs rgyas pa la bstod pa sngon dang mchod pa rjes la bya dgos/ 'dir tshig gnyis mi gsal/ nyer bsdu'i bar byas la gtor bsngo bya ba ni gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs kyis bsangs/ shū n+yā tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang /

sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ bhrūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing / rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub cing / rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa'i dbus su/ thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs padma sum cu so gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan dbus su bsham pa/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba sogs nas khro bcu la nyi ma'i gdan bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas rang skad cig gis don yod grub par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar yang 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad bsdus nas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyin pa tsam gyis sems can de rnams skad cig gis lha sum cu so gnyis su gyur nas/ so so'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ spro na dbus su zhe sdang rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can zhes sogs gtso 'khor rnams kyi zhal phyag gsal btab/ bsdu na dbus su zhe sdang rdo rje/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ zhes sogs dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i grar gzugs rdo rje ma nas/ gtso bo mdun du reg rdo rje ma'i bar/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du sa snying sogs nas/ g.yon du kun bzang gi bar/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed nas 'og tu gnod mdzes ces pa'i bar lha so so'i mtshan brjod la/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs so so'i rnam pa can/ bzhugs stabs dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur zhes brjod cing gsol btab rgyas bsdus gang ltar na'ang / de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa rang gi mdun du 'dus te bka' nod pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad khug ces bka' bsgos pas/ des rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor lha sum cu so gnyis la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzāḥ

bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo/ /gtor ma rnams/ bighnān gyis bsang / shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ā las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ padma dmar po as mtshan pa'i shar du gau las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu raṃ las rakta/ nub byang du shūṃ las byang sems/ byang shar du maṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de thams cad la oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng gi bar snang la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol te 'bar bar gyur/ steng gi zla ba rnams hūm̐ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas dkrugs shing / de nyid 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa shel ltar gyur/ padma āḥdang bcas pa las 'od 'phros dri ma med par nyi ma'i mdog can gyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ oṃ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kha nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med par spel zhing sba bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i rwa dbus ma la oṃ gyis mtshan pa de'i 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen phye ba'i phyag rgya dang /

༈ kyai rdor bde mchog sogs la'ang gtor ma byin rlabs logs su mi mdzad pa ha ho hriḥs mdzad/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ nas/ oṃ āḥsumbha rā dza pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lha sngags tshang ma lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra ne wi te āḥhūm̐ bar gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥha sogs kyi nang mchod rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes ba'i bar yongs grags kyis bden pa'i stobs brjod/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar yongs grags kyi phrin las bcol/ de nas kyai rdo rje sogs yi dam kyi lha dang / sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la rang rang gi phyag len bzhin gyi gtor ma phul/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'bul na phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la 'di nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ gtor snod kyi shar du skad cig gis dbang po ser skya glang po che la gnas pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa g.yas bi dza pu ra kā dang / g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha ri dwags la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/

dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa g.yas rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo padma la gnas pa/ g.yas dpang po khas len pa/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du/ lha klu gnod sbyin/ dri za lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding / mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ gnon po la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur pa las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ gtor mgron rnams kyis gong bzhin du gtor ma gsol ba bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ da shā dika a ba sbi te bhyaḥ.e he a ba sbi bhyaḥtsa/ dāe ba/ nā ga yakṣa/ gandha rwa/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍā/ kinnar/ ma ho ra ga bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsa/ unma dā/ a pasma ra/ osta ra ka a ti bhyo/ ba liṃ dā ba ya ma gre hi twa su kha/ swa ma na su lā bhi no bha wantu/ swā nalkani ru pa dra baṃ kurbantu/ sarba budha a dhiṣṭha ne na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ/ a mṛ ta paṣyi bhuktā/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra sya/ shintiṃ kurbantū/ swa sti swāhā/ rdo rje lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ghandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis bdud rtsi phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ phyogs bcu rnam par gnas rnams dang / /'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding / /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang / /smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang / /gnon po la sogs pa rnams la/

/gtor ma 'bul gyi bsnams nas kyang / /bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' ba la ni longs spyod nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje thugs kar bzung la/ rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos shing / /bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'byung po'i bdag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las bcol la gzhi bdag gtor ma 'bul/ de nas gtor bsngo gzhan dang sbrel na sngags bzla ba dang bstod pa sogs ci dgos bya/ lhag chad kha bskang nongs bshags brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol sogs skabs bstun bya/ ma 'brel na rdo rje 'chang gi gtor chog tu 'di rang gi 'das gtor dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor 'bul las ma gsungs 'dug kyang / 'das ma 'das kyi gtor 'bul gyi mtshams su dpal mgon zhal gyi gtor ma phul na legs pas/ de'i gtor chog rnams grangs mang yang gdan sa 'di'i phyag len ltar na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sogs nas/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol bar/ dril gsil dang zhal gyi sngags thung / dpal ldan srid gsum sogs shlau ka gcig dam rdzas mchod gtor nas bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod bar/ sa lo'i gsung rgyun gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin/ des na/ 'dir rang lugs kyi gtor chog rkyang pa byas tshe/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo'i rjes su yig brgya nongs bshags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ lha rnams rang gi lus la thim/ zhes brjod pa'i rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ 'jig rten pa rnams la badzra muḥs gshegs gsol/

rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ sgrub thabs bzhin dang / bkra shis ni/ gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /bde chen 'gyur med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang gsum 'dus ba'i rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs/ /khro bcu la sogs gdan gsum tshang ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bkra shis ci shes bya'o/ /de ltar dgong thun la sgrub thabs rgyas pa byas nas thun gzhan la bsdur rung ba ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ thun 'og ma gsum la/ sngar bzhin rgyas par bsgoms pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas bsrung 'khor nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yan chad/ dang po sbyor ba rdzogs par bsgoms la/ de'i mthar bzlas pa dang mchod bstod nyer bsdu sogs bya'o/ /de'i tshe lha mo'i lus la bsdu ba'i skabs su gdan rnams kyang rang la bsdu'o/ /thun bzhi ka'am rjes sam/ ma grub na thun tha ma'i mjug tu/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma 'bul te/ de'i cho ga yang kho bos logs su bkod pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pas de yi tshul ni/ srod tho rengs snga thun gsum la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nas bzung / nyams su blang bar bgyi'o bar byas la de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i༞ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal med pa'i༞ nye ring chags sdang dang༞ ces tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ swā bhā wa shūdhaḥsarba dhārmaḥswā bhā wa shūddho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum dang bral stong pa nyid du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la ye shes kyi tshogs so/

gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa la gsum gyi dang po bdag bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes shing / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i byang sems rdo rje lam nas lha mo'i padmar babs pa las hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje de las mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur ba thugs kar drangs/ badzra dhīka ces pas thugs ka nas phyir phyung / phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar gcig tu bsdus/ ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas/ rang la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba ni gdan du gyur pa'i steng du bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ rtsa zhal nag po khros pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ padma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gnyis pa gnas srung ba ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus khro bo bcu'i skur gyur nas rang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/

shar tu gshin rje gshed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang tu bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rnams khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad dang ldan pa/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng na g.yon bskyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pas bskyed pa zhal phyag sku mdog sogs lhag mos ltar bsam/ de nas/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa byung / mdun du 'dug ste/ bdag gi ci bgyis zhes bka' nod par gyur/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ grihṇa grihṇa hūm̐/ grihṇa pā ya grihṇa pā ya hūm̐/ a na ya hoḥbha ga wān/ bidya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje lcags kyur gyur nas/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis bsdigs bzhin pas bkug nas/ khro bo bcu la gtad pas/ phyi rol du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa'i nang du bcug par gyur/ byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i thugs ka nas/ rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnam pa can/ smad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can me 'bar ba bcu 'phros te phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor zug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṭṭaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dhā ra la adzña pā ya ti sarba bighnan kā ya wākka tsitta badzra ki la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes kyi lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me 'bar bar gyur nas/ phur bu'i spyi bo nas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar phug ste/

sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi bar son par phur bu'i btab pas/ lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ yid rnam par rtog pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par gyur/ gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/ khro bo rnams dang phur bu las me 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bgegs kyi 'khor gdug pa can rnams 'tshig cing phyogs bzhir bros/ me lce rnams slar bsdus phyi rol du me'i rwa bar gyur/ na maḥs manta kā ya wākka tsitta badzra naṃ/ ḍa ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ khro bo'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / nang du hūm̐ las gur dang / 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor srung ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la aḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod/ de nas zhe sdang rdo rje dang khro bcu la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bcu gcig bzlas la/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod pa sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgoms pa med/ /sgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgoms pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /snod bcud bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ye shes kyi bskyed pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum pa/ kha dog dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/

rlung g.yos me 'bar zhing chu bskol te/ des zhu nas thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la rdo rjes phyed pa'o/ /de'i steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i 'phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rin po che bre phul gyi steng gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang / rnga yab dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po me'i star bu/ steng du mda' yab padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs kyis bskor ba/ de dag gi bar snang rnams su rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur rtse bzhi'i gdugs bzhis mdzes shing / phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gzugs ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang / zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mo chos kyi 'khor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi'i sa bzhi la rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'o/ /de'i nang du lha snam rim pa gnyis shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i phyi nas 'od zer lngas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pa zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba shar tu 'khor lo/

lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng / rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i phyi'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs padma sum cu rtsa gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan gtso bo dang shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba dang / mā ma ki la rdo rje/ de ma gtogs pa'i lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la padma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan te/ thams cad kyang lha rdzas kyi rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes pas rten bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum/ lhag mos kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /dang po lhag mos ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo padma sngon po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum reg rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i sogs gong bzhin/ ral gri 'dzin pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje padma dkar po/ g.yon gong bzhin/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas na nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon na dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/

nub du 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i padma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs kar padma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la rin po che'i cod paṇa prog zhu la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o/ /shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje utpal dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo utpal sngon po rtsa ba dmar ba/ g.yon gong bzhin/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i utpal dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs kar utpal kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu dngos grub kyi cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i utpal/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/

dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje dang utpal dkar po/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi waṃ sngon po bsgrengs pa/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo dang utpal sngon po/ g.yon lhag mas gong bzhin/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis dri yi dung chos 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas gong bzhin/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang khu don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i utpal g.yon lhag ma gong bzhin/ gtso bo'i mdun du reg rdo rje ste lha mo dgu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg pa/ bzhin 'dzum zhing zur mig lta ba la sogs pas mdzes pa lang tsho dar la bab cing rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas brgyan pa 'dod yon lnga la rol pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su byams pa g.yon du sa snying gnyis dkar po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi byams pa'i g.yas dang pos klu shing gi me tog sdong po dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ sa snying gi g.yas dang po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'i g.yas lhag mas rdo rje padma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lha mo'i snam bu'i g.yas su phyag rdor g.yon du nam snying gnyis ser po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sogs rin 'byung ltar bskyed/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon du 'jam dpal gnyis dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/

dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sogs 'od dpag med ltar bskyed/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su sgrib sel g.yon du kun bzang gnyis ljang khu don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sogs don 'grub ltar bskyed/ de thams cad kyang zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu gra satwa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po ral gri/ g.yon snga ma dang 'dra ba/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na padma ral gri gtun shing / g.yon dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas dkur brten pa dang dgra satwa zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo gtun shing / g.yon gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang dgra satwa zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba g.yas lhag ma rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon lhag mas zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/

sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa padma dgra satwa 'dzin/ byang shar du stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje pad ma/ g.yon lhag mas sdigs mdzub dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa padma ral gri 'dzin pa/ khro bo thams cad kyang sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing / ha ha'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa/ gsus khyim che zhing 'phyang ba/ rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ste/ lhag mos kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o/ /de nas/ lha so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs te/ lha rnams kyi sku mthong bas sgrib pa dag byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud rnam par dag nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob pas rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsam pa lhag mos kyi mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor bzhi'i dang po sbyor ni/ rang gi snying rje'i 'od zer gyis lha rnams gdan dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor 'khod pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ snying kar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla rtsar don yod grub pa/ lte bar spyan ma/ snying kar mā ma kī/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ spyi bor sgron ma/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag rdor/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug snying khar 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje'i sgor sgrib sel/ tshig mtshams rnams su kun bzang / spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed/ g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ khar rta mgrin rdo rjer bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas pa mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gshin rje gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams rang gi phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams ngo bo dbyer med par gyur te/ rang gi lus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab las grub pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa dang / lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'o/ /de nas/ lus kyi lha rnam snang spyan ma/ gzugs rdo rje byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ gshin rje'i gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams 'od gsal du thim/ rin 'byung / mā ma kiā/ phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod rgyal rnams 'od gsal du thim/ 'od dpag med/ gos dkar mo/ dri rdo rje/ nam snying / rta mgrin/ dbyug sngon can rnams 'od gsal du thim/ don grub/

sgrol ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang / bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams 'od gsal du thim/ steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis reg rdo rje dang bcas pa 'jam dpal la thim/ 'jam dpal gtso bo mi bskyod pa la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa/ lhag mos don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o/ /oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal 'khor 'das de bzhin nyid du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsgom pa/ de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams steng nas steng du brtseg pa/ yig 'bru gsum dang padma yas mar thim/ nyi ma mas yar thim ste thams cad 'dus pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bur gyur/ de las 'od 'phros phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bsdus nas zla ba la thim pas/ rang gi sems 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ dharmā dha tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa zla ba las byang chub pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa sa bon las byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ yig 'bru gsum la thim pas/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ badzra ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsam bya grub mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa padma zlum po'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

mtshan dpes spras shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa/ sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ dang po'i mgon po'i thugs ka nas mi bskyod pa spros/ des nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par byas/ sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ slar sku gcig tu gyur pa bdag nyid la rjes su zhugs pas bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo padma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni sprul skur bsgyur ba'o/ /de'i lus kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon gnyis te bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi sna rtse bzhi ni rta bab bzhi/ rlung lnga ni rtsigs pa lnga/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ rgyu ma drwa ba/ rgyus pa drwa phyed pa/ byang sems dkar po zla phyed/ mig gi rnam shes me long / rna ba'i rnam shes ba dan/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi phreng ba/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ mig rta babs kyi steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan ma/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags/ sna rta babs la gnas pa'i ba dan/ lce dril bu/ rna ba sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang / zur gyi rdo rje rin po che/ lus kyi tshogs rnams rnga yab la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ yid dbang dbus kyi padma/ lte ba bum pa ste rdo rje 'chang gi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bor oṃ/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi ngo bo āḥ snying kar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐/ lte bar tshor ba'i ngo bo swā/ brla rtsar 'du byed kyi ngo bo ha/ lte bar sa khams kyi ngo bo laṃ/

snying khar chu khams kyi ngo bo māṃ/ mgrin par me khams kyi ngo bo pāṃ/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi tāṃ/ mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo thiṃlā/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo ā/ snying kar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sgor lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ/ tshigs rnams su tshigs mtshams kyi ngo bo paṃ/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus kyi ngo bo māaiṃ/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo hrīḥ rna bar sgra'i ngo bo hūm̐/ snar dri'i ngo bo baṃ/ lcer ro'i ngo bo ho/ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ/ lag pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ khar kha'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rjer rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐/ dpung pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ spyi bor spyi bo'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor gyur/ zhes brjod cing de rnams kyi ngo bor bsam pas/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis lus dkyil bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las spyan ma'i tshogs spros/ de dag gi rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnam snang spyan ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su gtso bo sku rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ /deng bdag༞ /rdo rje'i skus༞ /zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas/

rnam snang 'khor bcas bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas rang gi lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab bkang nas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs sku byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /lcer padma la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las gos dkar mo'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su gtso bo gsung rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ /deng bdag༞ /rdo rje gsung༞ /zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas/ 'od dpag med 'khor bcas bdag gi mgrin pa nas zhugs pas rang gi ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing / /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wakka badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs/ gsung byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba de las mā ma kī'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi bskyod pa mā ma kī'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo thugs rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/

/rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ /deng bdag༞ /rdo rje thugs༞ /zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas mi bskyod pa 'khor bcas bdag gi snying kha nas zhugs pas/ rang gi sems thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra 'gyur zhing / /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ste sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim de yongs su gyur pa las snying kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' gsung longs sku'i bdag nyid can yungs dkar gyi tshad tsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar thugs chos sku'i ngo bo ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ nag po 'od 'bar ba/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa snyoms 'jug mdzad de/ bdud rtsi 'dzags pas sems dpa' gsum tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs sgom pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi snying kha nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya phyung ste/ de khaṃ las rdo rje/ de las reg rdo rje ma sngon mo sogs zhal phyag rnams gong bzhin gsal btab/

de'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi ngo bo tāṃ/ zhes pa'i bar dang / sa snying la sogs par sems dpa' brgyad mi 'god par/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaḥnas rdo rje'i tshab tu/ bha ga'i rtse mor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ lag pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste de thams cad kyang lha'i ngo bor gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod cing / 'on kyang khro bo bcu'i skabs su rdo rje zhes pa'i dus su bha gar bha ga'i ngo bo hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lha yi ngo bor bsam pa'i tshe/ lag pa g.yas la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su khro bo bcu'i tshab tu ro lang ma la sogs pa khro mo bcur bsgom pa ste phyag rgya 'du byas pa'o/ /rang gi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ rtse mor oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la rdo rje padma 'du bya'o/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rdo rje dang padma'i nang 'od zer lngas gang bas rin 'byung du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs pas rang rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lus dkyil gyi lha thig ler zhu nas padmar bab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub sems kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsgom/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal chog gi sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir mi dgos/ gsum pa las rgyal chog la brgyad las/ dang po phra thig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gtso bor gsal ba'i rtsa zhal gyi sna rtser thig ler/ sems cung zad gtad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ yid kyi 'bru gsum ci nus su bzla'o/ /gsum pa ngag bzlas pa ni/
